## Course GitHub Repository

The teaching team has created a [GitHub repository](https://github.com/GatorAIM/gms6803-clinical-data-science) for the course to share course materials, sample scripts, and other resources

## Training Resources from UF Research Computing

- [HiperGator New User Training](https://docs.rc.ufl.edu/training/new_user_training/)
- Once the New User Training is completed, students are recommended to check out additional trainings on this page - [HiperGator Training](https://docs.rc.ufl.edu/training/HiPerGator_training/)
- UF Research Computing also offers [Practicum AI](https://practicumai.org) training module


## Questions or Concerns
- In case you have any questions - 
  - Post on Canvas Discussion Panel
  - Post on [GitHub issues](https://github.com/GatorAIM/gms6803-clinical-data-science)
